findings.message: Container $CONTAINER is running with a writable root filesystem. This may allow malicious applications to download and run additional payloads, or modify container files. If an application inside a container has to save something temporarily consider using a tmpfs. Add 'readOnlyRootFilesystem: true' to this container to prevent this.
